Kadamba_(?)
med. name of a work.

Kadambaka_(?)
viś. adv. Prativādibhayaṅkar p. 8. no. 15 (entered under prakīrṇaka works).

Kadambarāya_Mayūravarmacarita
on Mayūravarman founder of the Kadamba dynasty.

Kadambavana_(ºtīrtha,º_ºpurīº)māhātmya
or nIpavana (ºtIrthaº) nIpAraNyakSetraº or puruSottamaº paur. on Uttamarkoil (Bhikṣāṇḍārkoil Post) near Śrīraṅgam. In 6 chs. assigned to the Pūrvakhaṇḍa of Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa.
Adyar I. p. 145a.

Kadambavanamāhātmya
paur. Luck. Uni. p. 62.
--from Skānda. Mysore I. p. 179.

Kadambeśvara
son of Viśveśvara an. court-poet of King Pratāparudradeva Gajapati of Orissa; had the title Sūnṛtavādin.
--Jyautiṣasaṁhitārṇava.

Kadalītrirātravrata
for long, married life an. children. On Māghaśuklatrayodaśī from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa; but not found in ptd. text in Venk. Press edn.

Kadalīpuramāhātmya
on a place called Kadalī on the banks of the Kṛṣṇā, near Śrīśaila; in 25 sections. Said to be from Padmapurāṇa. Mack. p. 131.

Kadalīpūjanavidhi
dh. from Brahmāṇḍapurāṇa. but not found in Venk. Press edn; Bikaner 2078.

Kadalīprasava
dh. śānti. Ujjain II. p. 12.

Kadalīvivāha,_ºprayoga
or ºvidhi dh. on the ritual marriage of a person who is disabled or superseded to be gone through before the younger brother is married; called also Rambhodvāha.
Adyar I. p. 81a (2 mss.). PUL. I. p. 81.
--Āpast.
(two titles K. v. an. K. v. vidhi). Trav.

Kadalīvrata
dh. to be observed by ladies for saubhāgya.
--Ānandāśrama 5611. BISM. v.. 703/22. N. S. Press 84. Rajapur 731.

.
--from Bhaviṣyottara. To be done in Kārttika or Māghapūrṇimā.

Kādambakakalpa
alchemy. Īśvara-Pārvatī-saṁvāda; eulogizing a certain Kādamba hill on the Śatruñjaya mountains in Saurāṣṭra, whose mud is to be used in alchemy.

Kādambarī

Its plot taken from Guṇāḍhya's Bṛhatkathā (Somadeva's Kathāsaritsāgara 59. 22-178; Kṣemendra's Bṛhatkathāmañjarī 16. 183 ff.); the son not only closely followed his father's style but knew also the father's plan of the story. See
